identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting August 4 to 6, 2020
lines: 41.     Since the last policy meeting, CPI headline inflation prints have been released for

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting August 4 to 6, 2020
lines: three months – April, May and June – of which the numbers for April and May are imputed.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting August 4 to 6, 2020
lines: The provisional data for June shows headline inflation of 6.1 per cent compared to 5.8 per

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting August 4 to 6, 2020
lines: cent in March. Food inflation moderated somewhat from 7.8 per cent in March to 7.3 per cent

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting August 4 to 6, 2020
lines: in June, while rising in the interim to 10.5 per cent and 8.4 per cent in April and May,

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting August 4 to 6, 2020
lines: respectively. Fuel inflation rose slightly from 1.6 per cent in May to 2.7 per cent in June,

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting August 4 to 6, 2020
lines: reflecting the increase in international LPG and kerosene prices, although it was lower than

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting August 4 to 6, 2020
lines: the March level of 6.6 per cent. CPI inflation excluding food and fuel rose from 3.9 per cent

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting August 4 to 6, 2020
lines: in March to 5.4 per cent in June, portraying the increase in inflation in transport and

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting August 4 to 6, 2020
lines: communication, personal care and effects, pan-tobacco and education.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting August 4 to 6, 2020
lines: 42.     Going forward, a bumper rabi (winter) crop and a moderate increase in minimum

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting August 4 to 6, 2020
lines: support prices for the kharif crops, along with overall demand compression augur well for

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting August 4 to 6, 2020
lines: inflation. At the same time, however, upside risks to inflation include pressure on vegetable

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting August 4 to 6, 2020
lines: prices, continued supply chain disruptions, high taxes on petroleum products resulting in cost-

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting August 4 to 6, 2020
lines: push pressures, uncertainty regarding price changes in non-food categories, rising asset prices

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting August 4 to 6, 2020
lines: and volatility in financial markets. The headline print is expected to remain elevated in

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting August 4 to 6, 2020
lines: Q2:2020-21 and then moderate in the second half of FY: 2020-21 due to favourable base

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting August 4 to 6, 2020
lines: effects. This conforms with both the May and July 2020 rounds of the Inflation Expectations

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting August 4 to 6, 2020
lines: Survey of Households conducted by the Reserve Bank of India that show higher inflation

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting August 4 to 6, 2020
lines: expectations for the three-months-ahead forecasts compared to forecasts for the one-year-

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting August 4 to 6, 2020
lines: ahead horizon.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting August 4 to 6, 2020
lines: 43.     On the domestic output front, some signs of recovery were visible in June following

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting August 4 to 6, 2020
lines: the partial unlocking of some parts of the country. The ensuing increase in the number of new

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting August 4 to 6, 2020
lines: cases of COVID-19, however, forced the restitution of localised lockdowns, restraining

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting August 4 to 6, 2020
lines: growth in some high frequency indicators. Some indicators of urban consumption demand –

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting August 4 to 6, 2020
lines: passenger vehicle sales, domestic passenger air traffic and consumer durables – picked up

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting August 4 to 6, 2020
lines: slightly but continued to remain in deep contraction. On the other hand, some signs of

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting August 4 to 6, 2020
lines: recovery were evident in high frequency indicators of rural demand – tractor sales,

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting August 4 to 6, 2020
lines: motorcycle sales and production of consumer non-durables. High frequency indicators of

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting August 4 to 6, 2020
lines: investment demand remained weak, including consumption of finished steel, import of capital

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting August 4 to 6, 2020
lines: goods and capital goods production (as per the use-based classification of IIP), although the

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting August 4 to 6, 2020
lines: year-on-year contraction in cement production eased considerably in June. Contraction in IIP,

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting August 4 to 6, 2020
lines: year-on-year, moderated to (-) 34.7 per cent in May 2020 from (-) 57.6 per cent in the

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting August 4 to 6, 2020
lines: previous month due to the easing of lockdowns. Within manufacturing, only pharmaceuticals

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting August 4 to 6, 2020
lines: witnessed positive growth.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting August 4 to 6, 2020
lines: 44.    The Purchasing Managers’ Index (PMI) for manufacturing continued in the

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting August 4 to 6, 2020
lines: contraction zone, dropping to 46.0 in July from 47.2 in the preceding month. The PMI for

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting August 4 to 6, 2020
lines: services also continued in the contractionary zone while edging up to 34.2 in July, although

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting August 4 to 6, 2020
lines: contracting much less than in April and May. High frequency indicators of the services sector

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting August 4 to 6, 2020
lines: under construction and trade, hotels and transport – steel consumption, cement production,

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting August 4 to 6, 2020
lines: passenger vehicle sales, domestic passenger air traffic, railway freight traffic and commercial

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting August 4 to 6, 2020
lines: vehicle sales – contracted in June. Within financial and professional services, non-food credit

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting August 4 to 6, 2020
lines: growth remained muted.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting August 4 to 6, 2020
lines: 45.     Fortunately, growth in agriculture has held up, with the total area under summer crops

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting August 4 to 6, 2020
lines: (kharif) including rice, pulses, coarse cereals, oilseeds, cotton and sugarcane, up by 13.9 per

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting August 4 to 6, 2020
lines: cent as on July 31, 2020 over the corresponding period of last year and by 5.9 per cent over

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting August 4 to 6, 2020
lines: the normal area (5 years average).

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting August 4 to 6, 2020
lines: 46.     The Consumer Confidence Survey conducted by RBI in July 2020 shows that the

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting August 4 to 6, 2020
lines: overall Current Situation Index is at a historic low, while the Future Expectations Index

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting August 4 to 6, 2020
lines: reflects some optimism for the year ahead.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting August 4 to 6, 2020
lines: 47.    On the external front, the pace of contraction of India’s exports growth slowed down

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting August 4 to 6, 2020
lines: in June to (-) 12.4 per cent from (-) 43 per cent during March to May. Imports growth,

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting August 4 to 6, 2020
lines: however, dropped by (-) 47.6 per cent in June.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting August 4 to 6, 2020
lines: 48.    At the global level, the global manufacturing PMI and the global services PMI

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting August 4 to 6, 2020
lines: increased to 50.3 and 50.5, respectively, in July, and moved back to the expansion zone.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting August 4 to 6, 2020
lines: 49.     The prognosis for the economic situation is thus highly uncertain. There are some

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting August 4 to 6, 2020
lines: signs of revival, but the restoration of economic activity depends on how soon supply

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting August 4 to 6, 2020
lines: disruptions are repaired and demand revives. This depends, amongst other factors, on the

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting August 4 to 6, 2020
lines: severity of the evolving pandemic in terms of its depth, duration and diffusion and the control

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting August 4 to 6, 2020
lines: of infections, as well as the development of a vaccine.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting August 4 to 6, 2020
lines: 50.       Clearly, it is important to revive the economy and mitigate the impact of the

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting August 4 to 6, 2020
lines: COVID-19 pandemic, in line with the objective of monetary policy – to maintain price

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting August 4 to 6, 2020
lines: stability while keeping in mind the objective of growth. It is thus prudent to continue with the

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting August 4 to 6, 2020
lines: accommodative stance of monetary policy. At the same time, the mandate of the MPC is to

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting August 4 to 6, 2020
lines: achieve the target of CPI inflation (combined) of 4 per cent with the upper tolerance limit of 6

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting August 4 to 6, 2020
lines: per cent and the lower tolerance bound of 2 per cent.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting August 4 to 6, 2020
lines: 51.     In its attempts to revive the economy, the MPC has already front loaded cuts in the

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting August 4 to 6, 2020
lines: policy rate. In fact, before the COVID-19 pandemic hit the Indian economy, the policy repo

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting August 4 to 6, 2020
lines: rate was reduced by 135 basis points between February and October 2019 in response to the

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting August 4 to 6, 2020
lines: slowdown in economic activity. Since the outbreak of the pandemic, the repo rate was further

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting August 4 to 6, 2020
lines: cut by 75 basis points in the March MPC meeting and 40 basis points in the May meeting,

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting August 4 to 6, 2020
lines: amounting to a total cut of 250 basis points between February 2019 and May 2020 and 115

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting August 4 to 6, 2020
lines: basis points between March and May 2020. The monetary policy transmission to lending rates

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting August 4 to 6, 2020
lines: of banks has also improved, with a 91 basis points decline in the weighted average lending

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting August 4 to 6, 2020
lines: rate (WALR) on fresh rupee loans between March and June 2020. However, at the present

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting August 4 to 6, 2020
lines: juncture, the outlook for inflation is also uncertain, with risks more on the upside. Some

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting August 4 to 6, 2020
lines: clarity is also required with respect to the imputation of the April and May prints. In this

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting August 4 to 6, 2020
lines: context, CPI inflation data for at least two or three more months will be crucial for clearly

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting August 4 to 6, 2020
lines: gauging the impact of supply side disruptions and demand conditions on prices.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting August 4 to 6, 2020
lines: 52.     Considering the above factors, at this juncture, it is best to adopt a wait and watch

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting August 4 to 6, 2020
lines: strategy and look forward to incoming data to assess the evolving macroeconomic situation. I

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting August 4 to 6, 2020
lines: therefore vote to keep the policy rate unchanged and to continue with an accommodative

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting August 4 to 6, 2020
lines: stance as long as necessary to revive growth and mitigate the impact of COVID-19 on the

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting August 4 to 6, 2020
lines: economy, while ensuring that inflation remains within the target, going forward.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting August 4 to 6, 2020
lines: Statement by Dr. Ravindra H. Dholakia

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting August 4 to 6, 2020
lines: 53.     After the last MPC meeting in May 2020, changes in the economic environment were

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting August 4 to 6, 2020
lines: along the expected lines except the official announcement about the headline CPI and implicit

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting August 4 to 6, 2020
lines: inflation numbers during April, May and June. These high inflation prints coupled with the

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting August 4 to 6, 2020
lines: apprehensions about GDP growth likely to be negative both in real terms and nominal terms

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting August 4 to 6, 2020
lines: would imply that the economy is not caught up in recession with deflation but in a deep

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting August 4 to 6, 2020
lines: stagflation, which occurs when the adverse supply shock is more severe than the demand

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting August 4 to 6, 2020
lines: shock. Under such circumstances, expansionary aggregate demand policies – both monetary

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting August 4 to 6, 2020
lines: and fiscal – would result first in fueling inflation further rather than output and employment

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting August 4 to 6, 2020
lines: expansion and growth recovery, which is expected under recession with deflation. I have

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting August 4 to 6, 2020
lines: strong reservations in accepting the implicit inflation numbers for April and May announced

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting August 4 to 6, 2020
lines: by the NSO. I would, therefore, like to wait and watch for more reliable and realistic estimates

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting August 4 to 6, 2020
lines: of the headline inflation before taking any decision on the policy rate. I vote for status quo

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting August 4 to 6, 2020
lines: both on the policy repo rate and the stance. More specific reasons for my vote are as follows –

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting August 4 to 6, 2020
lines: i)   Price quotations collected for various items from the designated shops by NSO to

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting August 4 to 6, 2020
lines: measure inflation could not be collected during April and May because of the nation-

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting August 4 to 6, 2020
lines: wide lockdown. Even for June, the sample was not satisfactory to prepare the estimates

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting August 4 to 6, 2020
lines: for different states. Instead of leaving the gap in the CPI series, the NSO decided to

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting August 4 to 6, 2020

lines: Outlook

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: 13.     The inflation outlook is highly uncertain. As supply lines get restored in the

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: coming months with gradual relaxations in the lockdown, the unusual spike in food

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: inflation in April is expected to moderate. The forecast of a normal monsoon also

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: portends well for food inflation. Given the current global demand-supply balance,

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: international crude oil prices are likely to remain low although they may firm up from

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: the recent depressed levels. Soft global prices of metals and other industrial raw

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: materials are likely to keep input costs low for domestic firms. Deficient demand may

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: hold down pressures on core inflation (excluding food and fuel), although persisting

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: supply dislocations impart uncertainty to the near term outlook. However, volatility in

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: financial markets could have a bearing on inflation. These factors, combined with

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: favourable base effects, are expected to take effect and pull down headline inflation

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: below target in Q3 and Q4 of 2020-21.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: 14.     Turning to the growth outlook, economic activity other than agriculture is likely

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: to remain depressed in Q1:2020-21 in view of the extended lockdown. Even though

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: the lockdown may be lifted by end-May with some restrictions, economic activity even

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: in Q2 may remain subdued due to social distancing measures and the temporary

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: shortage of labour. Recovery in economic activity is expected to begin in Q3 and gain

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: momentum in Q4 as supply lines are gradually restored to normalcy and demand

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: gradually revives. For the year as a whole, there is still heightened uncertainty about

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: the duration of the pandemic and how long social distancing measures are likely to

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: remain in place and consequently, downside risks to domestic growth remain

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: significant. On the other hand, upside impulses could be unleashed if the pandemic is

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: contained, and social distancing measures are phased out faster.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: 15.     The MPC is of the view that the macroeconomic impact of the pandemic is

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: turning out to be more severe than initially anticipated, and various sectors of the

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: economy are experiencing acute stress. The impact of the shock has been

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: compounded by the interaction of supply disruptions and demand compression.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: Beyond the destruction of economic and financial activity, livelihood and health are

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: severely affected. Even as various measures initiated by the Government and the

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: Reserve Bank work to mitigate the adverse impact of the pandemic on the economy,

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: it is necessary to ease financial conditions further. This will facilitate the flow of funds

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: at affordable rates and revive animal spirits. With the inflation outlook remaining

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: benign as lockdown-related supply disruptions are mended, the policy space to

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: address growth concerns needs to be used now rather than later to support the

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: economy, even while maintaining headroom to back up the revival of activity when it

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: takes hold.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: 16.     Accordingly, all members voted for a reduction in the policy repo rate and

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: maintaining the accommodative stance as long as it is necessary to revive growth and

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: mitigate the impact of COVID-19 on the economy, while ensuring that inflation remains

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: within the target.
