lines: Statement by Dr. Chetan Ghate

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: 19.    Since the last review, the outlook for the economy has deteriorated further.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: 20.    Several high frequency indicators point to dire growth outcomes in the near

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: term. On COVID-19, we haven’t achieved the first goal, which is flattening of the curve.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: The “tug of war” between economic and health costs has led to some opening up of

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: the economy. The economy needs to be opened up smartly. The risk of prematurely

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: opening the economy is that there could be a surge in new cases. It takes time for

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: local epidemics to grow. The main growth challenge is that the top six industrialized

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: states produce 62% of India’s GDP. These are also the worst affected states by

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: COVID.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: 21.    Despite the dire growth outcomes, why have I voted for a 25 bps cut, and not a

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: larger amount?

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: 22.   First, it is not entirely clear to me that Covid-19 constitutes a large disinflationary

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: shock. Inflationary pressures fall with economic slack (the output gap), but rise with

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: expected future inflation and factors related to production costs.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: 23.     Both 3-month ahead and 1-year ahead inflationary expectations have spiked

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: sharply (by 190 bps and 120 bps respectively) in the latest round of RBI’s survey. This

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: spike reverses a relatively flat trajectory for inflationary expectations over the past six

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: rounds of surveys. It also reflects a sharp rise in food inflation in recent months. In

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: April, food inflation rose to 8.6% from 7.8% in March, and will likely remain elevated in

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: the coming months. This is worrisome. I continue to be concerned about declining

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: market arrivals of food commodities because of COVID related supply side bottle-

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: necks and their inflationary impact.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: 24.     When the economy turns to the upside, the recovery in demand will be swift.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: There has already been a severe dislocation in domestic and global supply chains. It

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: will take some time to for these to get resolved, and it is therefore likely that demand

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: will recover faster than supply.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: 25.    Currently, core inflation (inflation excluding food and fuel) continues to remain

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: moderate, with the April readings (not released by the CSO) likely to have been similar

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: to the March readings, or around 4%. Lower oil prices have not been passed on to

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: consumers at the pump because of a sharp hike in Central excise duties and increases

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: in VAT rates on petrol and diesel across States, cancelling out any beneficial effects

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: of lower oil prices on core inflation.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: 26.    Second, as I mentioned in the last review, in a demand deficient economy, a

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: large rate cut is akin to pushing on a string.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: 27.    For rate cuts to work, banks have to lend. Despite the large number of steps

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: taken to improve the liquidity and functioning of credit markets, as of April 24 (the most

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: recent data available), non-food credit growth on a y-o-y basis was at 6.5% on May 8,

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: 2020, lower than 7.2% on April 10, 2020.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: 28.    Third, rate cuts should be seen as part other measures that have already been

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: taken with respect to liquidity policy, social insurance policy, and fiscal policy in dealing

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: with the crisis.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: 29.    Since the last review, a comprehensive fiscal stimulus has been announced,

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: amounting to about 10% of GDP. The “Keynesian component” of the stimulus, i.e., the

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: part that increases discretionary spending via fiscal policy is however around 1% of

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: GDP.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: 30.     An ambitious Keynesian fiscal stimulus was always going to have to navigate

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: between Scylla and Charybdis: if the government spent too much on the discretionary

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: part of the stimulus, the yield curve would have gotten thrashed, banks would have

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: booked losses, and our credit rating would have gotten a downgrade. It would have

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: also signalled that the government is giving up on its commitment to controlling

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: inflation. If it spent too little, it risked a worsening of growth.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: 31.    To navigate the middle path, the government has focussed on much needed

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: structural reforms. This is prudent. The measured approach to the stimulus recognizes

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: the government cannot spend its way to prosperity without implications for financial

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: instability.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: 32.     Despite the small Keynesian component of the stimulus however, taking into

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: account the relaxation in state government borrowing limits, the combined state-centre

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: fiscal deficit is still likely to rise to around 10-12% of GDP in FY 21. I doubt if the bond

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: markets will shrug this off. That means transmission to credit markets will suffer,

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: making a large rate cut pointless. What compounds this is the rising risk aversion in

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: the financial system will get exacerbated by a looming spike in NPAs because of the

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: loan and mortgage holidays announced. This will hinder transmission even more.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: 33.     Fourth, since the last review, a variety of high frequency indicators have

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: declined sharply. There has been a broad based and deep contraction in the March

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: IIP (Index of Industrial Production) which fell to -16.7% from 4.6% in March. Passenger

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: vehicle sales have plummeted. Consumer non-durables have fallen by -16%.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: Indicators of fixed investment have tanked: finished steel consumption has declined

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: by -90.9%, and IIP Capital goods (which proxy for machinery and equipment) have

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: also fallen by -35.6%. PMI manufacturing declined to 27.4 in April from 51.8 in March

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: due to a sharp contraction in output and new export orders. The services PMI dropped

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: to 5.4 in April from 49.3 in March due to a sharp fall in business activity. Exports have

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: also fallen drastically by -60.3%.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: 34.    While these have no doubt resulted in a large negative output gap, it is also true

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: that potential output has also fallen.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: 35.    The only silver lining is the agriculture sector. The current Rabi crop has done

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: well. And the current summer sowing of crops (for rice, pulses, coarse cereals, and

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: oilseeds) is higher by 43.7% over last year.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: 36.     The strongest argument for a big rate cut would therefore be the dire growth

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: outcomes because of COVID. However, such rate cuts should be saved for when the

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: economy starts reviving, and not when we are in a lock-down. Rate cuts, assuming

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: that there is transmission and banks lend, works most effectively when the economy

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: is on the upside. The MPC should keep some gunpowder dry.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: 37.     Fifth, the reverse repo rate has been cut thrice in succession to 3.35%. The

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: idea behind the asymmetric cuts is to use the LAF corridor as an instrument of

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: monetary policy. For all practical purposes the reverse repo rate is now the effective

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: policy rate. I worry that the current quantum of liquidity will be difficult to unwind when

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: things return back to normal. RBI’s liquidity policy has helped stabilize financial

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: markets, but lender of last resort policies, as is widely recognised, are not useful

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: outside a crisis, and thus should not be viewed as part of normal monetary policy.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: 38.    Given the above reasons, I vote to cut the policy rate by 25 bps this time.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: 39.   I will continue to watch the incoming growth-inflation data carefully, and remain

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: data dependent.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: 40.    I also vote to retain the stance as accommodative.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: Statement by Dr. Pami Dua

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: 41.    The nationwide lockdown over the past two months due to the COVID-19

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: pandemic has severely impacted domestic economic activity, yielding a grim

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: prognosis for the economy. This unprecedented and extraordinary economic and

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: health crisis has also gravely affected the global economy with acute intensity and

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: spread.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: 42.     On the domestic inflation front, headline CPI inflation fell from 6.6 per cent in

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: February 2020 to 5.8 per cent in March. For the month of April, only partial information

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: has been released, providing the numbers for food inflation, which rose from 7.8 per

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: cent in March to 8.6 per cent in April, with prices of vegetables, pulses, edible oils, milk

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: and cereals being the prime drivers. However, low crude oil prices, soft global prices

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: of metals and other industrial raw materials, and weakening aggregate demand are

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: expected to soften inflation, although supply disruptions may impact inflation

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: adversely. Overall, headline inflation is expected to ease in the second half of

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: FY:2020-21 and fall below target. This also conforms with the May 2020 round of the

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: Inflation Expectations Survey of Households conducted by the Reserve Bank of India

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: that shows higher inflation expectations for the three-months-ahead forecasts

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: compared to forecasts for the one-year-ahead horizon.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: 43.     On the domestic output front, the evolving pandemic has had serious

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: ramifications for domestic growth, which is crippled by a near-standstill in economic

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: activity due to the lockdown and social distancing, leading to demand compression as

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: well as supply disruptions. High frequency indicators of urban consumption demand –

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: passenger vehicle sales, domestic passenger air traffic and consumer durables – fell

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: dramatically in March 2020. A similar dismal picture emerges in indicators of rural

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: demand – tractors sales, motorcycle sales and consumer non-durables – that plunged

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: sharply in the same period. Indicators of fixed investment also fell, with a sharp drop

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: in finished steel consumption in April and cement production in March, reflecting a

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: slowdown in construction activity. Moreover, capital goods production (as per the use-

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: based classification of IIP) declined by 36 per cent in March, along with a significant

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: drop in capital goods imports during March and April. While the data for the March

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: print of IIP has been compiled with limited sample due to the institution of the lockdown

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: from March 25, the preliminary data indicates a drop in IIP by almost 17 per cent, with

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: manufacturing falling by more than 20 per cent, infrastructure/construction goods by

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: almost 24 per cent and electricity by 6.8 per cent.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: 44.    The Purchasing Managers’ Index (PMI) for manufacturing declined sharply to

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: its lowest level of 27.4 in April from 51.8 in March, partly due to contraction in output

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: and new exports orders. The PMI for services dropped dramatically to an

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: unprecedented level of 5.4 in April from 49.3 in March, due mainly to a drop in business

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: activity, new business orders and new export business. High frequency indicators of

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: the services sector, in addition to those mentioned above (passenger vehicle sales,

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: domestic passenger air traffic), and including foreign tourist arrival, railway freight

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: traffic, and commercial vehicle sales, contracted in March/April.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: 45.    Fortunately, growth in agriculture has held up, with the total area under summer

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: crops including rice, pulses, coarse cereals and oilseeds up by 43.7 per cent as on

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: May 10, 2020 over the corresponding period of last year. Further, as per the third

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: advance estimates of crop production for 2019-20, production of foodgrains (kharif

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: and rabi) in 2019-20 is 3.7 per cent higher than the final estimates of the previous year.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: 46.    The Consumer Confidence Survey conducted by RBI in May 2020 also paints

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: a grim picture, showing that the overall Current Situation Index is at a historic low,

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: while the Future Expectations Index reflects high pessimism for the year ahead. Thus,

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: consumer sentiment has plunged to abysmally low levels.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: 47.    At the global level, the global manufacturing PMI plunged to an eleven year low

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: in April 2020, while the global services PMI sharply declined to a record low.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: Accordingly, India’s merchandise exports and imports witnessed record contractions,

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: with exports falling by 60.3 per cent in April 2020, while imports dropped by 58.6 per

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: cent.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: 48.      The economic situation is thus extremely gloomy. While the COVID-19

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: pandemic is a humanitarian and health crisis, the related lockdown has precipitated a

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: collapse in economic activity, which has come to a near standstill. Other than in the

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: agriculture sector, economic activity may continue to remain sluggish even after the

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: lifting of the lockdown, due to social distancing and shortage of labour as a result of

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: the migration of workers to their native places. In fact, GDP growth in FY:2020-21 is

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: expected to remain in negative territory, with some respite in the second half of the

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: fiscal year. The way forward in terms of restoration of economic activity thus depends

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: on the speed with which the pandemic is contained, how quickly the Indian economy

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: opens up, and how soon supply disruptions are repaired and demand revives. It will

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: also depend on the impact of the combined stimulus from fiscal, monetary, social and

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: administrative measures that have been implemented to create conditions conducive

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: to survival in the crisis, as well as for revival in growth. Over time, some reprioritisation

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: in government expenditure towards health infrastructure and capital expenditure may

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: also be desirable for promoting economic revival.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: 49.    The Government has outlined a comprehensive package in five tranches

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: covering, amongst other measures, rural employment creation, infrastructure creation,

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: focus on MSME sector and creation of an enabling business environment. The

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: package also includes relief measures for poorer sections of society and for resource

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: constrained state governments by increasing their borrowing limits. The measures

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: also encompass a number of major structural reforms, which are more long-term in

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: nature.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: 50.    The Reserve Bank of India has used conventional monetary policy measures

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: as well as unconventional monetary policy tools that supplement the conventional

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: measures in order to ease financial conditions and stimulate growth in the economy.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: It has also undertaken several measures to improve liquidity, monetary transmission

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: and credit flows to the economy, and provide relief on debt servicing.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: 51.    Before the COVID-19 pandemic hit the Indian economy, the policy repo rate

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: had already been reduced by 135 basis points between February and October 2019

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: in response to the slowdown in economic activity. Since the advent of the pandemic,

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: the repo rate was further cut by 75 basis points in the March MPC meeting, amounting

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: to a total cut of 210 basis points between February 2019 and March 2020. The

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: monetary policy transmission to lending rates of banks has improved with a 90 basis

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: points decline in the one-year median marginal cost of funds-based lending rate

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: (MCLR) between February 2019 and May 15, 2020. The weighted average lending

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: rate (WALR) on fresh rupee loans declined by 114 basis points between February

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: 2019 and March 2020 with a fall of 43 basis points in March itself.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: 52.     Given the severity and depth of the crisis, the macroeconomic impact of the

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: pandemic is turning out to be more severe than initially anticipated. Thus, in order to

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: revive growth and mitigate the economic impact of COVID-19, it is important to ease

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: financial conditions further. Accordingly, I vote for cutting the policy rate by 40 basis

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: points. This brings the total reduction in the policy rate since the start of the spread of

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: the COVID-19 pandemic to 115 basis points with the magnitude of cut in the easing

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: cycle that started in February 2019, (up to May 2020) being 250 basis points. In the

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: current scenario, with heightened uncertainty and a near-standstill in economic

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: activity, this may not necessarily lead to an immediate increase in borrowing, but

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: should raise consumer confidence and investor sentiment, going forward. I also vote

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: to maintain the accommodative stance as long as necessary to revive growth, while

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: ensuring that inflation remains within the target.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: Statement by Dr. Ravindra H. Dholakia

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: 53.     Continuing lockdown in the geographical areas that contribute a major share in

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: the Indian economy and worsening global economic situation due to COVID-19 has

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: now created a distinct possibility of the real GDP growth in India during 2020-21 to be

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: in the negative zone for the first time in the last 40 years. Even the nominal GDP

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: growth may slip into the negative zone. There are all symptoms of a recession – fall in

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: aggregate demand, negative real growth and high unemployment. The government

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: has provided a major fiscal boost through a series of announcements. The role of the

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: monetary policy under such circumstances should be to supplement and support the

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: fiscal efforts to bring the economy out of the unprecedented crisis. Without exhausting

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: all the space for policy rate cuts, in this meeting I, therefore, vote for a 40 bps cut in

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: the policy Repo Rate and maintaining the accommodative stance. More specific

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: reasons for my vote are as follows –

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: i)    Under the lockdown, measurement of consumer inflation and a survey of

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: household inflationary expectations are likely to quite problematic. The samples

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: would be truncated and undesirable biases may enter the estimates making

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: them unreliable and non-representative. Under such circumstances, I feel, the

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: model based forecasts provide a better guide. A very carefully carried out

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: forecasting exercise provides an estimate of headline CPI inflation around 2.8

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: percent for Q4 2020-21. Even accounting for uncertainties, a very conservative

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: estimate may be taken as 3.1-3.2 percent. Thus, inflation rising above the target

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: of 4 percent does not seem to be any concern for the policy right now.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: ii)    Although the real policy rate in most other comparator countries is zero or

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: negative, in India it is not only positive but relatively very high at around 1.2 to

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: 1.6 percent. I believe that the real policy rate needs to be kept positive but not

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: so high under the present conditions.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: iii)   The fiscal boost given by the Central government in several instalments is likely

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: to result in further slippage of the fiscal deficit to GDP ratio of only 150 bps.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: Similarly, all states together may raise their fiscal deficit to GDP ratio by about

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: 150 bps. Thus, the impact on the combined fiscal deficit to GDP ratio may be

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: confined to about 300 bps, which in my opinion is quite prudent under such

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: extreme conditions. It may not be inflationary and may result in growth recovery.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: iv)   Once the situation returns back to normal and the fiscal and monetary boost

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: measures start generating impacts, the recovering economy in my opinion may

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: require some further boost. It is prudent to preserve some space for the future.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: 54.    Considering all these factors, I vote for a 40 bps reduction in the policy repo

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: rate and maintaining the accommodative stance.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: Statement by Dr. Janak Raj

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: 55.      The impact of COVID-19 on economic activity has turned out to be much more

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: acute than initially expected with the nation-wide lockdown having been extended from

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: initial 3 weeks to 9 weeks. There is still uncertainty as to when the epidemiological

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: curve will flatten and this will continue to cloud the macroeconomic outlook for some

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: more time. Be that as it may, we are staring at a huge negative growth in the current

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: quarter and overall negative growth for the year as a whole. Both demand and supply

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: sides of the economy have collapsed. However, I believe that supplies would recover

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: much faster than demand. This is because capacity to produce goods and services by

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: and large remains intact, though non-availability of labour may temporarily hamper

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: production for a few months. On the other hand, however, there has been a substantial

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: loss of demand. A large number of daily labourers/wage earners have been rendered

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: jobless because of lockdown. Though a part of the unemployed work force will get

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: back to work, still there are some sectors which have been hit hard and many people

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: working in these sectors may have lost their jobs permanently. This will adversely

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: affect private consumption. Otherwise also, consumer confidence has been dented

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: and consumers are likely to cut down on discretionary spending.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: 56.     Within aggregate demand, while private consumption is likely to slowdown from

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: the pre-COVID-19 levels, what worries me more is investment demand, which is likely

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: to be impacted severely for a variety of reasons. First, given the collapse in demand,

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: excess capacity is likely to be created in many sectors. This, combined with huge

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: uncertainty about future demand, both domestic and external, is likely to hamper new

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: investments in the private sector. Second, financing of investment activity – from own

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: sources due to a decline in profitability or by borrowing due to weak balance sheets –

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: will also be a challenge. Third, the focus of government spending, both by the Centre

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: and the States, will also be on revenue expenditure than on capital expenditure. For

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: all these reasons, investment activity, which contracted in last two quarters, is

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: expected to be severely hit, going forward.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: 57.     Moving on to inflation, the NSO has released data only on the food and housing

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: groups for April 2020. Food inflation rose to 8.6 per cent in April from 7.8 per cent in

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: March. However, these numbers need to be interpreted with a caution as the rise in

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: food prices in April was caused by a disruption in supply lines and is transitory. The

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: wedge between CPI inflation and WPI inflation for food in April widened sharply by

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: more than 500 bps. While CPI food inflation increased by close to 80 bps in April, WPI

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: inflation declined by 190 bps from 5.5 per cent to 3.6 per cent, suggesting an increase

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: in margins at a retail level due to supply bottlenecks. Should monsoon be normal, as

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: it has been forecast, it should also have a salutary effect on food inflation. I, therefore,

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: feel that risks to food inflation, other than in pulses, are minimal at this stage and

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: overall food inflation is expected to resume its downward trajectory from May/June.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: 58.    Though the print of CPI fuel inflation was not available for April, data from oil

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: market companies suggest that domestic LPG and kerosene plunged in April in line

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: with a decline in global prices.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: 59.     Finally, we also do not have core inflation (excluding food and fuel) print for

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: April. The fall in international crude oil prices has not been passed on to domestic

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: pump prices of petrol and diesel. Though this makes domestic pump prices vulnerable

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: to any rise in international prices, on the current demand supply balance, oil prices are

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: likely to remain soft. Given the collapse in domestic demand, core inflation should

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: soften significantly from the current levels over the medium term. Input cost pressures

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: are also likely to ease due to a sharp decline in global commodity prices. Housing

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: inflation at less than 4 per cent during March-April was the lowest in the series. Gold

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: prices are expected to remain firm due to a flight to safety. On the whole, however,

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: core inflation is expected to remain benign over the next few quarters. Even though

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: there is expected to be a V shaped recovery, the economy will still be left with a

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: considerable slack, which will keep core inflation under check.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: 60.     To sum up, economic activity is expected to contract in 2020-21. While supply

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: lines are likely to be restored as lockdown is relaxed, demand would take far longer to

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: revive to pre-COVID levels. Even as some support will be provided by government

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: expenditure, overall consumption is likely to slow down due to a slump in private

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: consumption. More than private consumption, however, it is investment demand which

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: is expected to be hit hard in this uncertain environment and may be a huge drag on

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: economic activity in the near future with attendant implications for potential growth.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: Therefore, concerted efforts need to be made to revive investment demand. Overall,

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: inflation over the medium term is expected to be benign. Monetary policy has been

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: eased significantly since February 2019 and the Government has also taken several

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: measures, which will help mitigate deleterious impact of COVID-19 on aggregate

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: demand. However, an unprecedented collapse in demand calls for further easing of

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: financing conditions. With the likely contraction in economic activity and the inflation

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: outlook remaining soft, the policy space has opened up. I, therefore, vote for reducing

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: the policy repo rate by 40 basis points and keeping the stance accommodative as long

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: as it is necessary to revive growth, while ensuring that inflation remains within the

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: target. Given the long transmission lags with which monetary policy operates, it is

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: important to create enabling financing conditions so that economic activity takes off

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: swiftly as soon as normalcy is restored. Should the inflation trajectory turn out as

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: expected, some more policy space may open up, going forward. For monetary policy

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: actions to transmit fully to the credit market, it is important that banks remain well

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: capitalised. Only banks with strong balance sheets could be expected to support

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: lending activity as and when credit demand picks up.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: Statement by Dr. Michael Debabrata Patra

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: 61.    In my view, the destruction of economic activity by COVID-19 and ensuing

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: lockdowns is much more deleterious in terms of loss of basic livelihood, economic

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: security, health and confidence than the range of estimates/projections of GDP and

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: other macroeconomic aggregates suggest. In India, as in the rest of the world, external

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: trade, investment, manufacturing, services involving people – hospitality, tourism,

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: aviation and construction – and investment have been the worst hit. Private

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: consumption is tenuously holding on to positive territory, but spending patterns have

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: altered drastically away from the discretionary and to the essential. The large

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: monetary stimulus and fiscal effort are striving to put a floor under the aggregate

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: demand. At the current juncture, the all-out effort is to maintain and sustain, with the

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: hope that when life is secure, resources, energy and time can be marshalled to rebuild

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: and revive.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: 62.    In fact, my view is that the damage is so deep and extensive that India’s

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: potential output has been pushed down, and it will take years to repair.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: 63.   In the deliberations of the MPC, my view is that the threats to growth have to

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: be addressed frontally and aggressively, or risk a more dire outlook.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: 64.    Meanwhile, the prolonged lockdown has thrown supply into disarray and

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: interrupted the easing of inflation that had gotten underway after the January 2020

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: peaking. Contemporaneous information suggests that the momentum in the prices of

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: several food items, especially perishables, may be ebbing, with favourable

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: implications for the evolution of headline inflation going forward. This suggests that the

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: food price spike has very little persistence and dispersion (except in April 2020 when

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: the lockdown started producing wider effects), and can be looked through for policy

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: purposes. The sustained loss of momentum of seasonally adjusted GDP growth over

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: eight consecutive quarters is depressing the underlying momentum of core inflation,

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: and this is likely to continue in the near term, as aggregate demand would take time

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: to return to pre-COVID levels.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: 65.     Relative prices tend to adjust within the budget constraint. For setting monetary

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: policy, however, it is the absolute level of prices and its prospective movements that

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: matter. This warrants a careful assessment of aggregate demand. Apart from the

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: unidirectional loss of speed in real GDP growth, monetary conditions are also

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: reflecting the fragile state of demand. While reserve money adjusted for the first round

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: CRR effects is expanding substantially in relation to its pace a year ago, this essentially

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: reflects the large monetary stimulus and the public’s flight to cash – currency in

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: circulation expanded year-on-year by 18.4 per cent up to May 22, 2020 as against

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: 14.9 per cent a year ago. In the current milieu in which banks are depositing sizeable

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: balances with the Reserve Bank rather than lending/investing, the money multiplier at

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: which this reserve money expansion translates into money supply, has to be adjusted

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: to include LAF reverse repos, which are essentially (remunerated) excess reserves.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: With this adjustment, the money multiplier would have effectively declined from its

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: normal level of 5.5 to about 4.5. This is showing up in the rate of money supply which

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: has slowed below its secular trend; in fact, the negative money gap (actual rate of

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: money supply minus its trend rate) has widened since 2019-20, especially from the

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: second half. Both bank credit and investments are decelerating to multi-year lows,

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: pointing to badly dented demand and risk aversion. On the other hand, bank deposits

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: are growing faster than a year ago, driven by a precautionary savings instinct in these

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting May 20 to 22, 2020
lines: times of heightened uncertainty. It is important to break this recessionary loop, shore

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: sides, brought on by the pandemic could be severe. The need of the hour is to do

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: whatever is necessary to shield the domestic economy from the pandemic. Central banks

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: across the world have responded with monetary and regulatory measures – both

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: conventional and unconventional. Governments across the world have unleashed

lines: activity from the impact of the virus. To mitigate the economic difficulties arising out of the

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: virus outbreak, the Government of India has announced a comprehensive package of

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: ₹1.70 lakh crore, covering cash transfers and food security, for vulnerable sections of

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: persons and women. The MPC notes that the Reserve Bank has taken several measures

lines: to inject substantial liquidity in the system. Nonetheless, the priority is to undertake strong

lines: against the pandemic. Banks and other financial institutions should do all they can to keep

lines: 18.    In the last review, I had said “While I don’t see space for further cuts going forward,

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: I remain data dependent”

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: 19.    In the last six weeks, the data has turned in a significant way.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: 20.   Because of COVID-19, acute downside risks to growth have mounted. As

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: lockdown measures kick-in, the economic cost of COVID-19 could become large as

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: production declines in various sectors, and there is a permanent postponement of

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: consumption expenditure plans.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: 21.      A large decline in global growth will also affect our exports adversely. Growth in

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: the service sector, the largest sector in the economy, will also be affected because

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: discretionary spending will fall. It is important to understand that consumer services –

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: retail, hotels, restaurants etc. – are a corollary of growth. In contrast, producer services –

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: finance, IT, Real Estate, Transportation etc. - are producers of growth and also

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: employment. COVID-19 will impact both, slowing the momentum on the growth

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: turnaround that had set in in the last few months.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: 22.    Unfortunately, there is no short-cut at the current juncture apart from the lockdown.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: 23.   What should the monetary policy strategy be in this situation? There are three

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: considerations.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: 24.   First, monetary policy should minimize the fall in aggregate demand, i.e., we

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: should minimize the extent of permanent damage done to growth by the COVID-19 shock.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: Hence, the required cut in the policy rate should be large given the severity of the shock.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: What is required is in the nature of an insurance cut.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: 25.    In a demand deficient economy, a large rate cut, however, will be akin to pushing

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: on a string. I have been raising this concern in several previous policy reviews justifying

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: the need for more structural reforms. This concern prevents me from voting for an even

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: larger cut in the policy rate this time.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: 26.     Second, what is the appropriate division of labor between monetary policy, liquidity

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: policy, social insurance policy, and fiscal policy in stimulating aggregate demand?

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: 27.     I see the current fiscal stimulus (1.7 lakh crore which is about 0.8% of GDP,

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: announced on March 26, 2020) more in the nature or a relief measure (social insurance)

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: rather than a stimulus. A relief is not a permanent fix. The idea of the measure announced

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: by the government is to weather the storm so that no one has to go without food and

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: spending on essential items. The effect of this measure will be to lead to a small rise in

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: consumption in the short run, but the effect will dissipate quickly.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: 28.     On liquidity policy, a large number of measures will be announced today which

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: include prudential and forbearance measures. A series of liquidity measures have

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: already been enacted (Forex swaps, LTROs, operation twist, OMOs). Combined, these

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: measures amount to a “carpet-bombing” of the financial system with liquidity and will help

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: flatten yields in those parts of the financial system where fire-sales have pushed up credit

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: spreads. The stabilization of financial markets will help improve economic outcomes.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: 29.     On fiscal policy, I await details on a second stimulus package that will possibly be

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: announced by the government. The challenge will be this: estimates of the size of the

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: government spending multiplier internationally across a wide variety of studies, unless

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: the economy has a lot of slack or is stuck at the zero lower bound, tend to be small, and

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: typically smaller than one (an increase in Government spending by 100 Rs. increases

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: GDP by less than 100 Rs.). Tax multipliers, on the other hand, tend to be larger (greater

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: than one). This suggests that the ideal fiscal stimulus to deal with COVID-19 should be

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: loaded on the tax side rather than the government spending side. India however has

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: limited tax penetration. This is going to be the main design challenge.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: 30.   Finally, what is the threat to our medium term inflation aim because of the COVID-

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: 19 shock?

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: 31.     While it is hard to assess -- in a precise manner -- the one year ahead level of

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: inflation given the current situation, new disinflationary forces have emerged since the

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: last review, namely, an outsized reduction in crude because of geo-political factors, and

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: a possible acute slowdown in growth in FY: 20-21. Inflation ex-food and fuel could also

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: fall with lower crude prices and with an opening up of the output gap.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: 32.     I worry though that even though vegetable inflation has fallen sharply from 50% in

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: January 2020, it is still elevated at about 30% in February. Unseasonal rains, if any, and

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: COVID-19 related lasting supply side disruptions in the food sector also pose an upside

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: risk to the inflation trajectory in 2020-21. These need to be carefully watched.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: 33.   Taking monetary policy, fiscal policy, social insurance policy, and liquidity policy

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: together, a 50 bps cut in the policy rate is appropriate at the current juncture.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: 34.   As noted recently by former Fed Chairman Ben Bernanke in an AER article,

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: monetary policy has never proved able to reverse large shocks. It only helps to mitigate

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: the worse effects of shocks, and speeds up the recovery.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: 35.    Once the COVID-19 pandemic subsides, is there likely to be a quick return to

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: normal? I am hopeful because production capacity has not been destroyed. However, I

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: will watch the incoming growth-inflation data carefully, and remain data dependent.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: 36.    I also vote to retain the stance as accommodative.

lines: 37.    The near nationwide lockdown due to the COVID-19 outbreak has brought

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: economic activity to almost a standstill. The global economy has also been adversely

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: impacted by the unprecedented economic and humanitarian crisis, the severity of which

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: will depend on the depth, duration and diffusion of the evolving pandemic.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: 38.     Depending on the severity of the situation and the duration of the lockdown, the

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: crisis has ramifications for domestic growth stemming from supply side disruptions,

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: contraction in demand, slowdown in global growth and a loss in consumer confidence as

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: well as investor sentiment. The supply chain of key industries is likely to be disrupted due

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: to restricted access to imported raw materials. The manufacturing sector is expected to

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: drastically slow down due to closure of factories while consumer demand and investment

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: spending are also likely to drop sharply. The services sector is expected to be impacted

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: the most due to restrictions on travel, transport, hospitality, tourism, and professional and

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: financial services. Construction activity is also expected to drop. Trade is expected to take

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: a hit due to a fall in domestic demand and contraction in global growth. Since the shock

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: to output is global, it is unlikely that any country can act as an engine of growth to pull the

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting March 24, 26 and 27, 2020
lines: world out of this situation.
