lines: Statement by Dr. Urjit R. Patel

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 6-7, 2018
lines: 61.    CPI inflation rose for the sixth consecutive month in December. Food inflation

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 6-7, 2018
lines: increased further even as pulses continued to deflate. Fuel group inflation rose sharply in

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 6-7, 2018
lines: November and remained elevated thereafter. With rising input prices, inflation is getting

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 6-7, 2018
lines: increasingly generalised. Inflation expectations have remained elevated.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 6-7, 2018
lines: 62.     Looking forward, inflation in the baseline scenario is projected to remain above the

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 6-7, 2018
lines: target of 4 per cent throughout 2018-19. There are several upside risks to inflation, especially

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 6-7, 2018
lines: from the staggered impact of HRA increases by various state governments (the direct effect

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 6-7, 2018
lines: on the CPI of the pure statistical adjustment has to be looked through, but not the second

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 6-7, 2018
lines: round effects driven by, say, expectations); policy for arriving at the minimum support prices

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 6-7, 2018
lines: for Kharif crops; and the fiscal slippage as indicated in the Union Budget, which also has

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 6-7, 2018
lines: attendant “crowding-out” implications with regard to the cost of private domestic credit. The

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 6-7, 2018
lines: evolving global macro backdrop is a concern. Tighter monetary policy by systemically

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 6-7, 2018
lines: important central banks, viz., the US Federal Reserve, combined with a looser US fiscal

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 6-7, 2018
lines: policy stance has the potential to imbue financial turbulence with concomitant consequences,

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 6-7, 2018
lines: especially for emerging markets. International crude oil prices increased significantly

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 6-7, 2018
lines: between December and early February, which is worrisome. However, oil prices could

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 6-7, 2018
lines: moderate if there is a strong supply response. Effective supply management by the

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 6-7, 2018
lines: government, as in the recent past, could help in keeping food inflation under check. Further,

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 6-7, 2018
lines: overall capacity utilisation in industry, according to surveys, is restrained.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 6-7, 2018
lines: 63.     Domestic economic growth impulses are strengthening. Manufacturing activity has

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 6-7, 2018
lines: picked up. The manufacturing purchasing managers’ index (PMI) expanded for the sixth

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 6-7, 2018
lines: consecutive month in January, led by new orders. There are also early signs of revival of

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 6-7, 2018
lines: investment activity. Many service sector indicators have shown robust growth such as

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 6-7, 2018
lines: commercial vehicle sales, domestic & international air passenger traffic, and foreign tourist

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 6-7, 2018
lines: arrivals. The services PMI expanded sequentially in December and January, supported by

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 6-7, 2018
lines: higher business activity. Credit growth is picking up and is also becoming broad-based. GVA

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 6-7, 2018
lines: growth in 2018-19 is forecast at 7.2 per cent, which will be a significant improvement over the

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 6-7, 2018
lines: current year.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 6-7, 2018
lines: 64.    Although inflation risks have increased in recent months, incoming data should

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 6-7, 2018
lines: provide greater clarity about the persistence of inflationary pressures. The economic

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 6-7, 2018
lines: recovery is also at a nascent stage and calls for a cautious approach at this juncture. I,

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 6-7, 2018
lines: therefore, vote for keeping the policy repo rate on hold while maintaining a neutral stance.

lines: Statement by Dr. Chetan Ghate

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017
lines: 25.    The Union budget has largely adhered to a path of fiscal consolidation as shown in

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017
lines: both the continuous decline in the revenue deficit and fiscal deficit. The focus in the budget

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017
lines: on reducing revenue expenditure without compromising on capital expenditure suggests that

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017
lines: the budget will not add to the inflationary momentum of the economy.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017
lines: 26.     There is more clarity on the impact of demonetisation on real output in terms of its

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017
lines: temporary component and its permanent component. The temporary (adverse) effect is

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017
lines: getting reversed as the economy remonetises. This is confirmed by various enterprise surveys

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017
lines: conducted by the Reserve Bank since the last review. What is a little more uncertain is the

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017
lines: permanent effect, which will operate through wealth destruction, and work more gradually.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017
lines: Even so, the permanent (adverse) effect is not likely to be large in the long run. Overall, and

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017
lines: as I mentioned in the last review, it appears that uncertainty on the production side has

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017
lines: largely been mitigated. Since I do not see a persistent opening up of the output gap because of

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017
lines: demonetisation, this does not warrant a rate cut.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017
lines: 27.     Unlike production, uncertainty in the price level persists because of demonetisation

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017
lines: obfuscating some of the trends that existed before November 8. While both 3 month and 1

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017
lines: year median inflationary expectations have fallen, it is unclear whether this will sustain.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017
lines: While fire sales have led to vegetable prices collapsing, vegetables always have a seasonal

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017
lines: rebound. In fact, inflation net of vegetables continues to remain at 4.8 per cent, and

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017
lines: momentum in food inflation increased in December. Inflation excluding food and fuel

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017
lines: remains sticky, and since it is above headline inflation, this will exert upward pressure on

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017
lines: headline inflation. These arguments suggest that a quicker pace of disinflation may not

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017
lines: sustain on a durable basis. With a shift in focus towards the mid-point of the medium-term

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017
lines: inflation target of 4 +/- 2 per cent, these arguments warrant no change in the policy rate.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017
lines: 28.     While the Indian economy is very different now compared to the summer of 2013, the

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017
lines: impact on financial markets of the possible ending of re-investment of principal payments by

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017
lines: the US Fed from its balance sheet holdings needs to be watched carefully. Such a “balance

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017
lines: sheet reduction” by the Fed may impart volatility.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017
lines: 29.   Taking into account these considerations, I vote for keeping the policy repo rate

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017
lines: unchanged at 6.25 per cent at today’s meeting of the Monetary Policy Committee.

lines: Statement by Dr. Pami Dua

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017
lines: 30.     While the transitory effects of demonetisation on inflation and output gap have yet to

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017
lines: be fully assessed, the ratio of currency in circulation to GDP is on the rise, suggesting that

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017
lines: remonetisation is progressing well. Furthermore, in the aftermath of demonetisation, due to

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017
lines: the increase in liquidity with the banks, banks have already reduced the marginal-cost-based

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017
lines: lending rates which should fuel demand in the economy. The Budget is also conducive to

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017
lines: growth in the key sectors and is expected to have multiplier effects. On the inflation front,

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017
lines: while CPI inflation has softened primarily due to lower food prices, core inflation (excluding

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017
lines: food and fuel) remains sticky, close to 5 per cent, partly due to rising international

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017
lines: commodity prices. The Survey of Professional Forecasters conducted by the Reserve Bank

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017
lines: also indicates that core CPI inflation is likely to remain sticky around 5 per cent till Q3-2017-

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017
lines: 18. On the external front, exports growth is likely to continue to provide support to the

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017
lines: economy, but volatility in the foreign exchange markets is a concern. Moreover, while the US

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017
lines: Fed maintained the status quo on interest rates, it is expected to hike rates in the future.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017
lines: 31.     Furthermore, the international leading indexes produced by the Economic Cycle

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017
lines: Research Institute (ECRI) indicate stronger global growth and inflation prospects for the

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017
lines: coming months. The continued cyclical upswing in ECRI’s U.S. Future Inflation Gauge (that

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017
lines: anticipates U.S. inflation) points to further increases in inflation. Further, the strength in

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017
lines: leading indexes of U.S. economic growth signal higher economic growth. Both these factors

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017
lines: may be consistent with multiple Fed rate hikes this year.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017
lines: 32.   Taking the above considerations into account, I vote to keep the policy repo rate

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017
lines: unchanged at 6.25 per cent.

lines: 33.     Surveys conducted by the Reserve Bank to provide input for the Monetary Policy

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017
lines: indicate that: a) the capacity utilisation may decline marginally; b) cost of raw materials is

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017
lines: likely to rise and firms may lose pricing power; c) investment outlook may remain subdued;

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017
lines: d) lack of clearances and lack of funds are the major reasons for the stalled projects; e)

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017
lines: inflationary expectations are declining for three months and one year ahead; and f) sentiments

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017
lines: on employment and household income have worsened. These findings are consistent with

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017
lines: our view that demonetisation of high value currency notes would have transitory adverse

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017
lines: impact on growth of income and employment. The Economic Survey 2016-17 by the

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017
lines: Ministry of Finance also corroborates the transitory nature of the impact though their estimate

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017
lines: of the slowdown in the growth is marginally higher than the Reserve Bank’s forecast. In any

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017
lines: case there is a general agreement that the growth in the coming quarters is likely to pick up

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017
lines: with the economy returning to its pre-demonetisation growth path.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017
lines: 34.     In this context, the Union Budget for the year 2017-18 presented on the 1st February

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017
lines: 2017 has been very pragmatic and disciplined providing adequate boost to help the economy

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017
lines: return to its pre-demonetisation growth path. However, the State Budgets have been the

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017
lines: cause of concern of late because the movement in their fiscal deficits largely determines the

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017
lines: variation in the combined fiscal deficit of the country. States have now started forming a

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017
lines: larger proportion of the public expenditures and having a clear idea on their fiscal deficits is

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017
lines: important for the monetary policy.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017
lines: 35.    While the commodity prices are firming up, the wholesale price index (WPI) for

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017
lines: manufacturing shows very low inflation. Since the items affected by it in the CPI do not have

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017
lines: high weightage, the CPI inflation without food and fuel continues to be high around 5 per

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017
lines: cent. The decline in overall CPI inflation is not reliably stable because it is mainly on account

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017
lines: of vegetables and pulses coupled with the transitory impact of demonetisation.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017
lines: 36.     As the transitory impact of demonetisation recedes and remonetisation sets in, the

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017
lines: banks’ MCLRs are likely to increase marginally. Moreover, under the current global

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017
lines: environment, the real neutral rate of interest in India seems to be higher than the one for most

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017
lines: of the developed countries. However, their future policy direction indicates rapid

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017
lines: strengthening of the rates.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017
lines: 37.    Given all these factors, it is prudent not to tinker with the policy rate at this stage. In

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017
lines: any case, under the given circumstances and reasonable forecasts for the future, I find the

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017
lines: current rate to be optimal for liquidity in the economy. Therefore, a change of stance from

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017
lines: accommodative to neutral at this stage is desirable. It can impart the necessary flexibility for

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017
lines: the monetary policy in future to respond to any development on either side.

lines: Statement by Dr. Michael Debabrata Patra

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017
lines: 38.     I vote for keeping the policy rate unchanged and for starting the withdrawal from

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017
lines: accommodation in the policy stance for three compelling reasons. First, the recent sharp

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017
lines: disinflation is entirely driven by transitory forces. Underneath, there is a broader-based

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017
lines: firming up of inflation pressures. Excluding vegetables, CPI inflation was 4.8 per cent, 136

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017
lines: basis points above the headline number of 3.4 per cent in December. Vegetable prices may

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017
lines: have been impacted by demonetisation, but they also exhibit strong seasonal behaviour and

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017
lines: tend to turn up as the winter gets over. Excluding food, inflation was 4.7 per cent; and

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017
lines: excluding both food and fuel, inflation was 4.9 per cent. Moreover, all of these levels have

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017
lines: become persistent since September 2016. Secondly, the reflationary effects of remonetisation

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017
lines: are likely being underestimated in the commentary around it. With transactions requirement

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017
lines: of currency amply met, the positive shock that is travelling through the economy can be

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017
lines: expected to fuel inflation well before the more sluggishly moving activity and demand

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017
lines: respond. If the seasonal upturn in vegetables prices and these reflationary effects coincide as

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017
lines: they might by as early as March-April, monetary policy needs to be preemptively on guard.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017
lines: Thirdly and importantly, forward-lookingness necessitated by lags in transmission requires

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017
lines: monetary policy to centre its focus now on the mandated inflation target of 4 per cent –

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017
lines: deviations out of the tolerance limits around the target for nine months consecutively will no

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017
lines: longer be tolerated. This acquires some urgency because the tailwinds that propelled inflation

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017
lines: down through 2014-17, some fortuitous like the collapse of international commodity prices,

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017
lines: do not appear to be in sight over the next 12-month horizon. Instead, upside risks from global

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017
lines: financial turbulence, international crude prices and a less than normal south west monsoon

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017
lines: could individually materialise and even intensify together into a perfect storm.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017
lines: 39.     It is eminently possible that the reasons cited above do not turn out to be so

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017
lines: compelling and even dissipate. That will open up headroom for monetary policy to more

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017
lines: directly address the objective of growth. If, on the other hand, they turn out to be real and

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017
lines: present dangers, it is vital to unfetter monetary policy from a unidirectional stance.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017
lines: Statement by Dr. Viral V. Acharya

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017
lines: 40.    This was a tough policy decision to take.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017
lines: 41.     On the one hand, headline inflation has remained low, and there is a good case to be

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017
lines: made that there is at least a temporary output gap created due to liquidity shortage induced by

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017
lines: the currency replacement. Since our flexible inflation targeting mandate also requires paying

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017
lines: attention to growth, it could be natural to lower the policy rate to restore growth levels,

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017
lines: especially if the lower policy rate could be passed onto the areas of the economy most

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017
lines: affected by the liquidity shortage, in particular, rural households, non-bank finance

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017
lines: corporations which undertake most of the auto-based lending, and the realty sector.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017
lines: 42.     On the other hand, low headline inflation has been largely driven by food deflation,

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017
lines: and the most recent numbers have been heavily driven by the large dip in vegetable prices. In

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017
lines: the past, food deflation has had strong seasonal patterns which have tended to rebound and

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017
lines: with vengeance when rainfall disappoints. While some of the food deflation over the past

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017
lines: few months has been steady due to supply-side factors, on balance it is fair to draw the

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017
lines: conclusion that statistically, food component of headline inflation has had less signal to noise

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017
lines: quality compared to the core inflation that excludes fuel and food, the latter having been more

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017
lines: or less sticky in recent months. Rapid remonetisation implies likely swift reversal of the

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017
lines: aggregate demand loss and the significant transmission to borrowers of easy funding

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017
lines: conditions at banks suggests unlikely further transmission of a rate cut by banks.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017
lines: 43.     Given the difficulty in resolving this trade-off between temporary effects on output

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017
lines: gap and the persistent nature of core inflation, my attention turned heavily to international

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017
lines: factors. Global uncertainty in trade due to protectionist tendencies in major developed

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017
lines: economies, the prospect of a stronger dollar in wake of a probable "border tax" on imports in

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017
lines: the US, and rising world-wide inflation in food, fuel and metals, have created a significant

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017
lines: risk to domestic inflation. Second-round effects on funding costs due to portfolio outflows

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017
lines: from debt and equity markets could be substantial if the central bank is not perceived as

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting February 7-8, 2017

lines: 20.     Because of the increased uncertainty due to the withdrawal of SBNs, and

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 6-7, 2016
lines: virtually no hard data for November, it would be prudent to ‘wait-and-watch’.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 6-7, 2016
lines: 21.     While a negative demand shock because of the withdrawal of SBNs will lead

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 6-7, 2016
lines: to a decline in consumption demand, the risks that such a reduction will have longer

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 6-7, 2016
lines: term effects by impinging on overall investment sentiment and investment activity are

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 6-7, 2016
lines: low. The risks that weakening aggregate demand could exacerbate a current type of

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 6-7, 2016
lines: “credit cycle” where a weakening of the real economy leads to a reduction in bank

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 6-7, 2016
lines: profits, leading to credit restrictions which further weaken the real economy, are also

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 6-7, 2016
lines: low. What counters the adverse effects of the withdrawal of SBNs is the aggressive

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 6-7, 2016
lines: pace of digitisation, and the fast restoration of the transaction demand for money

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 6-7, 2016
lines: from the re-tendering process. I therefore expect the demand and supply effects from

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 6-7, 2016
lines: the withdrawal of SBNs to be transient with the accompanying increase in the output

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 6-7, 2016
lines: gap likely to be temporary. This makes it inappropriate to respond with a rate cut.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 6-7, 2016
lines: 22.    My paramount concern at this juncture has to do with the stickiness of inflation

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 6-7, 2016
lines: excluding food and fuel. While headline inflation declined in October, inflation

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 6-7, 2016
lines: excluding food and fuel increased to 4.9 per cent in October, and remains sticky

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 6-7, 2016
lines: despite favourable base effects. It may be that a decline in core only comes after

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 6-7, 2016
lines: there is a substantial decline in inflationary expectations. Since the last review, there

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 6-7, 2016
lines: has also been a reversal of the non-food commodity cycle (e.g., metals, oil). Having

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 6-7, 2016
lines: said this, food inflation declined sharply in October although cereal inflation has been

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 6-7, 2016
lines: increasing gradually, and pulses and products continue to be major contributors of

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 6-7, 2016
lines: food inflation. While cereal prices may be constrained by buffer stocks, vegetable

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 6-7, 2016
lines: inflation is transient in nature, with possible reversals in trend. What is comforting

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 6-7, 2016
lines: though is that fewer commodities are driving inflation now compared to last month,

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 6-7, 2016
lines: which means that inflation is less generalised. Some disinflation will also come about

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 6-7, 2016
lines: because of the withdrawal of SBNs, although with a lag.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 6-7, 2016
lines: 23.    Despite a 175 basis points cut in the policy rate between January 2015 and

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 6-7, 2016
lines: November 2016, the reduction in the weighted average lending rate (WALR) on

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 6-7, 2016
lines: outstanding rupee loans for data up to September 2016 was only 71 basis points.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 6-7, 2016
lines: Because of imperfect interest-rate pass through so far, an additional cut at this

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 6-7, 2016
lines: juncture may not yield any further transmission from banks.

lines: 24.   Once the union budget is announced in the first week of February, there will

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 6-7, 2016
lines: be one more data point.

lines: 25.   Taking into account these considerations, I vote for keeping the policy repo

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 6-7, 2016

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 6-7, 2016
lines: Committee. I also believe that the Committee should now focus on the mid-point of

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 6-7, 2016

lines: 26.     On the basis of the Indian leading indices produced by the Economic Cycle

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 6-7, 2016
lines: Research Institute (ECRI), it can be inferred that the Indian economy was in a

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 6-7, 2016
lines: resilient state ahead of the decision to withdraw SBNs. It may be noted that a leading

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 6-7, 2016
lines: index predicts changes in economic activity and thus, cyclical turns in the economy.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 6-7, 2016
lines: Specifically, with the Indian Leading Index growth in a clear cyclical upswing and

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 6-7, 2016
lines: rising to a two-year high before the withdrawal of SBNs, the economic growth outlook

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 6-7, 2016
lines: going into the autumn months had become increasingly optimistic, underscoring the

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 6-7, 2016
lines: economy’s resilience to potential negative shocks. Thus, from a business cycle

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 6-7, 2016
lines: perspective, at the time, the Indian economy was not vulnerable. Moreover, growth

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 6-7, 2016
lines: in ECRI’s Indian Leading Exports Index, a harbinger of India's exports growth, was

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 6-7, 2016
lines: also in a decisive cyclical upturn. This indicates that improved exports growth may

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 6-7, 2016
lines: provide additional support to growth in economic activity, particularly in the context of

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 6-7, 2016
lines: the brighter global growth prospects suggested by ECRI’s global leading indices. In

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 6-7, 2016
lines: this backdrop, the withdrawal of SBNs is expected to have only a transitory impact on

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 6-7, 2016
lines: economic activity.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 6-7, 2016
lines: 27.    Moreover, with a cumulative reduction in the policy rate by 175 basis points

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 6-7, 2016
lines: since January 2015, conditions are conducive for further transmission to lending

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 6-7, 2016
lines: rates by banks. Meanwhile, in the light of higher international bond yields and a

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 6-7, 2016

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 6-7, 2016
lines: the U.S. Federal Reserve is expected to raise its policy rate this month.

identifier: Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee Meeting December 6-7, 2016
lines: 28.    Keeping in view the above, I fully endorse the resolution to keep the policy
